page.layout: One blank page with stains and show-through; no printed text blocks. Only the paper, dark staining on the left and small spots, and the edge of the neighbouring page or binding at the left and right edges.
page.notes: Blank leaf. No printed text, headings, running head, page number, catchword or signature can be read. The dark marks on the left, the small round spots and the stains are damage or paper discolouration, not print. The dark strip at the far left is the book's edge or background, not text.
